title: ZnS/MgF2 Dual-Cavity Dual-Band Bandpass Filter
scientific_hypothesis: A dual-cavity Fabry-Perot structure using ZnS/MgF2 Bragg pairs can simultaneously achieve high transmission at 3.25-3.35 μm and 4.20-4.30 μm while suppressing 2.50-3.10 μm and 4.45-5.00 μm within 22 layers.
design_principle: High refractive index contrast between ZnS (n~2.4) and MgF2 (n~1.35) in mid-IR enables strong Bragg reflection with fewer layer pairs. Two optical cavities separated by a central Bragg mirror create two transmission peaks at designed wavelengths. Literature L01 and L17 demonstrate ZnS-based multilayers on CaF2 for MWIR applications.
proposed_topology: Air | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 (cavity 1) | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS (cavity 2) | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | MgF2 | ZnS | Daimon-20 substrate. Total 22 coating layers.
design_variables: Individual layer thicknesses for all 22 coating layers
Cavity layer thicknesses for peak wavelength positioning
manufacturing_considerations: ZnS and MgF2 are conventional e-beam evaporable IR dielectrics
Ion-assisted deposition may reduce stress per L01
theory_basis: Fabry-Perot cavity resonance theory for bandpass filtering
Bragg mirror reflectance scaling with index contrast and pair count
expected_advantages: High index contrast reduces required layer count
ZnS/MgF2 well-established for MWIR per L01 and L17
Dual-cavity topology naturally produces two transmission bands
known_risks: ZnS may have absorption features near 4.5 μm affecting suppression band
Stress accumulation in 22-layer stack on CaF2
Cavity coupling may create unwanted transmission peaks between bands
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer dielectric multilayer coating on CaF2 (Daimon-20) substrate with air incidence. Stack sequence from air side: MgF2, ZnS, MgF2, ZnS, MgF2, ZnS, MgF2 (cavity 1), ZnS, MgF2, ZnS, MgF2, ZnS, MgF2, ZnS (cavity 2), MgF2, ZnS, MgF2, ZnS, MgF2, ZnS, MgF2, ZnS, terminating on CaF2 (Daimon-20). All 22 layer thicknesses are optimizable variables. Wavelength range 2500-5000 nm. Target high transmittance at 3250-3350 nm and 4200-4300 nm. Target low transmittance at 2500-3100 nm and 4450-5000 nm. No metal layers. Unpolarized light at 0 degree incidence.
revision_reason: Repaired CaF2 material name to Daimon-20 per registry resolution requirement
